title: Strazz Robinhood MCP
tagline: An MCP server for market research and risk-managed trading
summary: A Model Context Protocol server that gives an AI assistant safe, structured access to brokerage data — quotes, positions, fundamentals, and portfolio state — plus an execution path that is explicitly risk-managed and defaults to paper trading rather than live orders.
highlights: Built on MCP, so the same toolset works with any MCP-capable client rather than being tied to one assistant.
Risk controls and a paper-trading mode are part of the design, not an afterthought — the safe path is the default path.
Backed by a substantial automated test suite covering the tool surface and trading logic.
methodology: Exposed brokerage capabilities as discrete MCP tools with typed inputs, so an assistant can compose them without free-form scraping.
Separated research/read-only tools from anything capable of placing an order, and gated execution behind explicit risk checks.
Defaulted to paper trading so the system can be exercised end to end without risking capital.
Maintained roughly 56 test modules alongside linting and coverage tooling to keep the trading logic verifiable.
Kept credentials strictly in environment configuration, never in the repository.
galleryNote: No screenshots are published for this project. It is a private repository, and its interface surfaces real brokerage account data — positions, balances, and order history — which should not appear in a public portfolio.
